answer.why: Both FreightCar America and Trinity Industries design and manufacture freight railcars (hoppers, gondolas, etc.) for the North American market, serve the same customer types (railroads, lessors, shippers), and offer repair/rebuilding services alongside their manufacturing operations. FreightCar America explicitly calls itself a "Pure Play manufacturer" [T:P2.3], while Trinity describes its platform as "an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities" [C:P1.6] — meaning Trinity's primary revenue driver is its lease fleet rather than manufacturing. This creates a material business-model difference (asset-light OEM vs. asset-heavy lessor), but both companies manufacture the same railcar types sold to identical buyer groups in North America, satisfying the "same product AND same customers" test for a direct peer. The leasing/asset-ownership emphasis at Trinity is a meaningful nuance for valuation (different capital structure and multiple basis), but the core industrial business is the same.

T:P1.2.text: At FreightCar America, our team, facility and wide variety of freight car offerings are purpose-built, tailored to meet your unique needs. Every railcar is manufactured and designed to the highest standards—and backed by industry-leading experts who provide comprehensive field support and training. We ensure that every railcar is a product of deep collaboration, ingenuity and an unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction.

T:P1.3.text: At FreightCar America, we deliver top-tier railcar products, innovative engineering and strong industry relationships. At FreightCar America, excellence isn’t just a goal—it’s our promise.

T:P1.4.text: At FreightCar America, we specialize in premium railcars, conversions, rebodies and exceptional parts and service. By actively listening and learning, we consistently exceed your railcar needs, delivering reliable solutions with every interaction. Choose FreightCar America for unmatched excellence and dependability.

T:P1.5.text: We design and manufacture durable steel, stainless steel, aluminum and hybrid steel-aluminum freight cars for a wide range of bulk commodities and containerized freight. Our expert team collaborates with you to deliver tailored railcar solutions. With a state-of-the-art facility, we produce over 20 conversion designs and an expanded portfolio, including open-top hoppers, covered hoppers, gondolas, flats, intermodal cars, boxcars and well cars (articulated and standalone).

T:P1.6.text: FreightCar America is the leader in rebuilding and repurposing freight car assets. From complete car rebodies to transforming unused railcars into the latest designs, FreightCar America delivers customer-focused solutions.

T:P1.7.text: Get the railcar parts you need from one reliable and knowledgeable source. We have a large, in-stock inventory of high-quality forged, cast and fabricated parts for all freight car types, regardless of the original builder.

T:P1.8.text: When you purchase a FreightCar America railcar, the experience doesn’t end after your railcar is delivered. FreightCar America provides a Standard Repair Procedures resource library.

T:P1.9.text: Our commitment to quality and customer service begins with the first customer contact and extends through the life of the railcar. Our customer service department is staffed by a highly qualified and experienced team with the resources to help with any of your service requirements.

T:P2.2.text: The newest, purpose-built railcar plant in the world. Welcome to the FreightCar America Castaños, Mexico plant.

T:P2.3.text: As a Pure Play manufacturer, we focus on what we do best—building railcars. This dedication to our craft inspires us to collaborate with our customers, lessors, and suppliers to deliver tailored solutions.

T:P2.4.text: FreightCar America designs and manufactures steel, stainless steel, aluminum and hybrid steel-aluminum freight cars that transport a wide variety of bulk commodities, containerized freight and other products. Our experienced team works closely with you to create customized railcar solutions for all your needs.

T:P2.5.text: As FreightCar America celebrates 125 years, we remain the only railcar manufacturer with a legacy of producing cars that have performed across hundreds of millions of miles. With our meticulous craftsmanship, proprietary welding process and quality control procedures, we proudly deliver durable, high-performance railcars that meet or exceed industry standards. FreightCar America has an unwavering commitment to structural integrity and excellence in every aspect of railcar manufacturing.

C:P1.2.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

C:P1.3.text: Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

C:P1.4.text: Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

C:P1.5.text: It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail shippers moving forward.

C:P1.6.text: TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.

C:P1.7.text: years in business 50+ years manufacturing railcars, 40+ years leasing railcars

C:P1.8.text: major commercial end markets serving 21 different commodity markets with the broadest railcar product offering in North America

C:P1.11.text: As a leading railcar lessor enabled by rail transportation manufacturing and services in North America, Trinity Industries is committed to supporting a more sustainable future and making meaningful contributions to address our long-term impact.

C:P1.12.text: We are dedicated to integrating sustainability principles, including socially responsible and environmentally conscious corporate practices, grounded in a robust governance framework to ensure we continue operating at the industry's highest standards.

C:P2.1.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - About Us

C:P2.2.text: Trinity began providing industrial products and services to customers more than 85 years ago. We started as a small butane-tank manufacturer and evolved over time into a premier provider of railcar products and services in North America with a leading railcar lease fleet and manufacturing, maintenance and repair operations.

C:P2.3.text: Our rail-related products and services are marketed under the trade name TrinityRail. Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

C:P2.4.text: The TrinityRail platform plays an important role in the North American supply chain by facilitating the transportation of bulk commodities and goods by rail. Railcar transportation is sustainable and is the most economical land-based mode of transportation. At Trinity, we strive to employ company resources in ways that make positive contributions to our stakeholders for the benefit of current and future generations.
